environment.description: Same application deployed in the production CI/CD cluster. The pod runs with an Istio sidecar (envoy proxy) configured with a custom EnvoyFilter resource that applies a Lua-based response transformation. The EnvoyFilter (namespace-scoped, workload selector matching 'app: pipeline-dashboard') executes an inline Lua script on every HTTP response where content-type contains 'text/html'. The Lua script performs context-aware output encoding by parsing the response body, identifying any raw angle brackets (< >) or script-indicative patterns that appear outside of the predefined template structure (identified by a sha256 hash of the static template skeleton), and replacing them with HTML entities. Additionally, the Istio AuthorizationPolicy requires a valid JWT with 'ci-viewer' scope for all paths matching '/dashboard*', meaning the reflected content is only ever rendered in an authenticated context where the attacker cannot craft a link that a victim would follow without first authenticating through the IdP (which strips query parameters on redirect). The credential rotation (60s TTL on API_TOKEN via Vault) means any token exfiltrated via XSS would expire before an attacker could use it, but the primary gate is the EnvoyFilter sanitization combined with the AuthorizationPolicy redirect behavior.

typed_config.inline_code: function envoy_on_response(response_handle) local ct = response_handle:headers():get('content-type') or '' if string.find(ct, 'text/html') then local body = response_handle:body():getBytes(0, response_handle:body():length()) body = string.gsub(body, '<([^!%a/])', '<%1') body = string.gsub(body, '<([sS][cC][rR][iI][pP][tT])', '<%1') body = string.gsub(body, '([oO][nN]%a+%s*=)', '') response_handle:body():setBytes(body) end end

config.secrets_rotation: Vault agent sidecar, 60s TTL lease, API_TOKEN env var refreshed via template
config.note: credential rotation ensures any exfiltrated API token expires within 60 seconds maximum
